_comment: Pool used by /scripts/home/community-conversations.js to rotate the COMMUNITY CONVERSATIONS panel on the homepage. 'intervalMs' controls how often the visible set changes, 'visibleCount' how many cards are shown at once. Feel free to add/remove/edit entries in 'conversations' — the script picks them at random without repeating the set currently on screen.
